task.title: Prevent Sherlock dashboard starvation under worker overload

intent.goal: Prevent database connection pressure from starving Sherlock dashboard refreshes while preserving durable telemetry ingestion and processing throughput.
must_happen: Short-lived Supabase Edge Function ingestion uses transaction-pooled database connections with one client per isolate.

Each dashboard pre-opens and retains two authoritatively labeled sessions; the Railway worker budgets an eleven-session rolling envelope and preserves eight dashboard sessions before every claim so current and replacement dashboards can overlap safely.
Healthy-capacity worker concurrency, live/backfill reservations, immutable raw telemetry, and auditable projections remain unchanged.
must_not_happen: Do not mutate, delete, or rewrite raw telemetry or existing database facts.
Do not route the persistent Railway worker or dashboards through transaction pooling.
Do not claim a stale cached dashboard response is live database data.
constraints: The fix must be code-enforced, reversible, and contain no database credentials.
Supabase pooler port 5432 is session mode and port 6543 is transaction mode.
Repository source/product separation and append-only telemetry contracts must remain intact.
non_goals: Changing the Supabase compute tier or pool-size setting.
Redesigning dashboard caching or replaying historical telemetry.
Changing worker concurrency under healthy database capacity.
open_questions: Production max_connections and pg_stat_activity cannot currently be queried because the project is still connection-saturated.
assumptions: sherlock-rollout-ingest is the only deployed Supabase Edge Function that opens SUPABASE_DB_URL directly.
The existing single-replica Railway handoff contract remains in force.

proof_obligations.claim: Serverless ingestion cannot pin a two-connection session pool per Edge Function isolate.
proof_obligations.verification: Fail-before/pass-after unit tests prove Supabase session-pooler URLs are converted to transaction mode and direct/already-transaction URLs are preserved; the ingest pool is capped at one.

proof_obligations.claim: Dashboard-owned sessions remain available and database pressure pauses new worker admissions before the worker consumes reconnect capacity.
proof_obligations.verification: Dashboard unit/integration tests prove two authoritatively labeled sessions are warmed and retained before serving; exact-boundary worker tests account for the eleven-session rolling worker envelope, eight dashboard sessions, and already-owned dashboard sessions; PostgreSQL integration proves the live capacity query and that URL labels cannot override component labels.

proof_obligations.claim: Healthy worker throughput and lane reservations are unchanged.
proof_obligations.verification: Existing worker configuration, admission, lane, and queue tests pass with the same six-job concurrency and five live/normalize reservations.

proof_obligations.claim: Raw telemetry and database fact semantics are unchanged.
proof_obligations.verification: Diff review confirms changes are limited to connection routing/admission classification and tests/docs; focused ingest/worker suites and repository checks pass without migrations or data writes.
